description: A candlelit dark room with a wooden table, an open book, a small crucifix and a lit candle. A man in a dark suit with a white cravat stands centre, one hand raised, leading a group of about six young men in early-19th-century coats and cravats who press hands to their chests or clasp hands. A seated man at the table in the foreground has his hands folded. Shuttered window behind, no visible text, frame or border; the painting fills the image edge to edge.
